summary: This session's own work, for /gt:gt-work: findings, decisions, open items, files changed.
prompt_delta: The material is the write-back notes of one work session, split into segments: each segment is one finding, decision, open item or file changed.

Your unit is ONE segment file (the `path` input). Return the finding it records with its source -- a command and what it printed, a file and line, or the user's own statement -- and its verification state. A segment that only narrates what was tried, with no result, yields no finding.

For a session: a finding is research; a decision with its why is decisions (an ADR); architecture is design; a fact the next session in this project needs is memory; a platform fact is a knowledge CANDIDATE (promotion is a later, approved step); an open item is a handoff item -- use dest inbox for it and say so in why.
You are also the SKEPTIC for this session: read each finding as a claim that has to earn its place.

Flag: figures with no stated source or measurement; causal claims stated as fact but only observed once; words like always, never, fixed, proven or verified that the entry does not back up; results generalised beyond what was tested; anything whose verification state (verified, inferred, assumed) is not stated.

For each flag say which entry, which words, what kind of problem (unverified, overclaimed, unsupported-number, stale, scope), why, and the smallest edit that would make the entry honest. Do not rewrite entries and do not flag style. You advise; the session decides.

flags.description: Objects {entry, quote, kind, why, suggested_fix}; kind is unverified|overclaimed|unsupported-number|stale|scope.

clean.description: Titles of entries with nothing to flag.
